next.reason: 1985: "A signed numeric literal must have associated with it a signed numeric PICTURE character-string."; 2023: "shall be either a signed numeric data item or a numeric-edited data item with a representation of a sign.". Same subject, but 2023 adds a case: a signed numeric literal may also initialize a numeric-edited item that has a sign representation. 1985 allowed only a signed numeric PICTURE.
